raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

DeepEP v2 currently selects expanded dispatch and CPU synchronization from `enforce_eager`. Use `do_expand=False` and `do_cpu_sync=False` for every forward so eager execution, warmup and CUDA graph capture share the same dispatch contract.

Remove the constructor flag and unused expanded-layout receiver code. Preserve DP-wide, sequence-parallel-aware receive-capacity buckets, padding masking and GPU receive metadata. Allow preparation without a forward context by falling back to the input shape.

Expanded dispatch needs an expert backend that consumes grouped rows efficiently. Enabling it for large prefills is deferred to a backend-specific follow-up with rank-coordinated policy, tuning and serving validation. Capacity-based allocations may use more memory than the previous synchronized eager path; this PR claims no general speedup or memory reduction.

Duplicate-work check: open DeepEP PRs were inspected. #51589 proposes opt-in adaptive prefill dispatch; this change makes non-expanded dispatch unconditional. It does not duplicate #50511's padding fix or #59687's SP buffer sizing fix. Future expanded-prefill work should coordinate with #51589.

AI assistance was used for implementation, review and validation. The human submitter is responsible for reviewing every changed line, running relevant tests, and defending the change.

## Test Plan

Exercise prepare/finalize contracts and BF16/FP8 expert outputs across eager execution, capture/replay and return to eager. Validate exact 8k/16k synthetic prefills, full GSM8K, and non-overloaded 8k-input/1k-output serving with `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`.

## Test Result

<details>
<summary>Validation results, reproduction commands and limitations</summary>

Merge resolution `3dab3e92b5` (2026-10-13) merges main `624a5ddafd` and preserves its deferred expert-side routing globalization with unconditional non-expanded dispatch. The existing capture-transition contract now covers both standalone and deferred globalization. All applicable pre-commit hooks passed (including mypy and DCO); `git diff --check` passed. Five CPU contracts passed using the edited implementation with explicit dependency shims, not native DeepEP/CUDA. Native pytest could not load the repository conftest because the local environment lacks `regex`; DeepEP is also unavailable. GPU/model validation has not been rerun on this merge revision; the historical results below retain their stated revision limits.

Cleanup revision `c3726d0063`: independent agent review found no unresolved issues; all applicable pre-commit hooks passed. Four isolated CPU contracts passed against the edited implementation, using dependency shims (not native DeepEP/CUDA). The contract suite is now included alongside the MoE suite in the two-B200 Buildkite job. GPU/model results below were run before the dead-code cleanup and have not been rerun on the final cleanup revision.

GPU validation source `b8b6e0a5d3dad211fece907652ba5cab0cdd8e76`; candidate `80be71926f78838448b2026aa28665df7001e532` applies it to pinned main `d09ff7763747bbe7cd153edd8017479804f47be7`. Run `pr59337-capture-state-20261006-r13` uses model `RedHatAI/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8-block` revision `6b2399be90eff484848cbbabd684930e01400d54`, image `docker.io/vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:0ad6fa4178c34f4e04402452bbc4294df6dd2fb2785a0ecd402b2861aea2a189`, and report-card `59dcfb2a36827c450eb6ddb1d9d8f7e91e62ae58`. DP2/EP on two B200 GPUs on healthy `b200-02`, fixed 8 GiB KV allocation per GPU. Model context 32768, max batched tokens 16384, max sequences 32, prefix caching disabled.

- All applicable commit-time pre-commit hooks, including mypy and DCO sign-off, passed; Ruff, formatting, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Prepare/finalize contracts: **4 passed**; two-GPU MoE suite: **17 passed**, no failures/errors/skips.
- Both synthetic variants completed all 100 measured iterations at 8k and 16k after five warmup iterations. The previously failing 16k case now passes; this does not establish the cause of the old expanded-path timeout.

| ISL per DP rank | PR graphs enabled | PR enforce-eager |
|---|---:|---:|
| 8192 | 110.89 ms | 116.30 ms |
| 16384 | 266.88 ms | 276.34 ms |

Times are coordinated forward completion per exact batch, not HTTP TTFT/TPOT. One fresh process per configuration; no statistical significance claimed. Large received shapes can exceed the normal FlashInfer tuning range and use fallback tactics. The earlier graph-enabled main reference was 111.14/268.21 ms at 8k/16k; it is historical, used a different GPU allocation on the same healthy node, and is not a fresh paired control.

| Synthetic case | Sampled peak GPU A / GPU B (GiB) |
|---|---:|
| Graphs enabled, 8192 | 32.75 / 32.71 |
| Graphs enabled, 16384 | 36.22 / 36.13 |
| Enforce-eager, 8192 | 34.58 / 34.58 |
| Enforce-eager, 16384 | 36.90 / 36.90 |

Full GSM8K: **88.93%**, 1319 questions, five shots, temperature 0, seed 42, max output 256, concurrency 8, zero invalid answers. This passes the configured 85% evaluation threshold. The earlier 89.76% result used a different 2k batched-token budget; this run uses 16k, so it does **not** establish matched accuracy parity.

Serving benchmark: exact 8192-token inputs / 1024-token outputs, four warmup requests then eight measured requests, 0.05 requests/s, concurrency <=2, burstiness 1000, seed 100, ignored EOS. **8 completed, 0 failed**, 65536 input / 8192 output tokens. Mean TTFT **131.69 ms**, TPOT **5.218 ms/token**. Sampled waiting requests and preemption counters were zero. No fresh matched serving baseline or serving speedup claim.

Serving sampled GPU peaks: **32.60 / 32.25 GiB**. Synthetic NVML samples are 100 ms, serving NVML samples one second, restricted to measurement phases. These include allocator reservations, can miss transient allocations, and follow earlier workload steps; no blanket no-worse memory claim. Successful measurement windows were checked for complete GPU/RSS telemetry. The serving process ran with `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` and completed without a checker error.

Commands:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/kernels/moe/test_deepep_v2_async_finalize.py -vv -s
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/kernels/moe/test_deepep_v2_moe.py -vv -s
PYTHONPATH=/work/vllm:/scripts/report-card-worker.pyz \
VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0 VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 \
.venv/bin/python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone \
  --nproc-per-node=2 /scripts/rank_driver.py pr1
# Repeat synthetic run with pr-eager and its enforce_eager=True resolved spec.
.venv/bin/python /scripts/gsm8k.py /results/pr59337-capture-state-20261006-r13/serving/pr-graph
.venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve \
  --backend vllm --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
  --model RedHatAI/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8-block --tokenizer "$PINNED_MODEL_SNAPSHOT" \
  --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1024 \
  --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 8 \
  --request-rate 0.05 --burstiness 1000 --max-concurrency 2 \
  --seed 100 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$CASE_RESULTS"
```

Full scripts, source hashes, pinned model/image identities, per-rank reports, XML/logs, evaluation outputs, benchmark results and telemetry are retained under `/results/pr59337-capture-state-20261006-r13` on Pirate's `tms-shared-cache` PVC. Local analysis is recorded in `report-card-r13/summarize.py`. The matrix and serving validation completed with Job exit 0; temporary RDMA quota was restored.


Superseded expanded-policy experiments are omitted from this description. Their logs remain under `/results/pr59337-capture-state-20261006-r11` and `...-r12`; they do not validate this revision.

</details>
